description: This file defines the class `TestDataService` in the `OrangeHRM\Tests\Util` namespace. It provides utility methods for loading, populating, and managing test fixture data for the OrangeHRM application, including database setup and teardown, fixture parsing, and entity object creation.

classes.name: TestDataService
classes.description: A utility class for managing test fixture data, database setup/teardown, and fixture parsing in the context of unit tests for the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Public static method to populate the database with fixture data from a YAML file, with an option to reset cache.

methods.name: _populateUsingPdoTransaction
methods.description: Private method to populate data using PDO transactions, handling cache usage and database constraints.

methods.name: _generatePdoInsertQueryArray
methods.description: Generates SQL insert queries for fixture data for a specific table alias.

methods.name: _generateMultipleInsertQueryArray
methods.description: Generates multiple SQL insert queries for each data item in fixture data.

methods.name: _generateInsetQueryColumnString
methods.description: Creates a column list string for SQL insert statements based on an array of data.

methods.name: _getTableName
methods.description: Retrieves the table name associated with a given alias.

methods.name: _getClassMetadata
methods.description: Returns Doctrine ClassMetadata for a given entity alias.

methods.name: _setData
methods.description: Loads fixture data from a YAML file and processes encryptions and table names.

methods.name: _encryptFieldsInFixture
methods.description: Encrypts specified fields in fixture data before database insertion.

methods.name: getFQEntityName
methods.description: Resolves the fully qualified class name for an entity alias.

methods.name: _setTableNames
methods.description: Sets up table names from fixture data for later database operations.

methods.name: _disableConstraints
methods.description: Disables foreign key constraints for database operations.

methods.name: _enableConstraints
methods.description: Enables foreign key constraints after database operations.

methods.name: _truncateTables
methods.description: Deletes all data from specified tables and resets auto-increment counters.

methods.name: _getDbConnection
methods.description: Returns the PDO connection used by Doctrine.

methods.name: truncateTables
methods.description: Public static method to truncate tables by their aliases.

methods.name: truncateSpecificTables
methods.description: Truncates specific tables based on provided aliases.

methods.name: fetchLastInsertedRecords
methods.description: Fetches the last N records inserted for a certain entity.

methods.name: fetchLastInsertedRecord
methods.description: Fetches the most recently inserted record based on an order criterion.

methods.name: fetchObject
methods.description: Fetches an entity object by primary key.

methods.name: parseFixtureFile
methods.description: Parses a fixture YAML file and caches the result.

methods.name: loadFixtures
methods.description: Loads fixture data for a specific key from a YAML fixture file.

methods.name: loadObjectList
methods.description: Loads a list of entities from fixture data, returning entity objects.

methods.name: loadObjectListFromArray
methods.description: Creates a list of entity objects from an array of fixture data.

methods.name: getFieldForColumn
methods.description: Resolves the entity field name for a given database column name.

methods.name: getTypeForField
methods.description: Determines the data type of a given entity field.

methods.name: getAssociationMapping
methods.description: Returns the association mapping for a given entity field, if any.
